summary.text: New Argive is a nation and the largest of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, formed by Kjeldor and Balduvia after the Ice Age and known for its archaeologists, historians and walled fortifications.

bio.text: Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes merged their nations into New Argive twenty years into the Thaw, after Jodah persuaded them to stop fighting.
New Argive rallied against Varchild and later secured control when the Cult of Rimewind failed to undo the Thaw.
The Sheoltun Empire conquered it, and the Argivians pushed them out with the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels.
At New Argive, Rith let four dragon lords incinerate themselves with mana, and Treva was reborn.
It was devastated in the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovered, then faced infiltration by Cabal agents.

In the recent Phyrexian war Stenn told Karn that King Darien had ordered a search for Phyrexian agents and that New Argive would mobilize, and Raff healed Teferi of a grave wound in a New Argive watchtower.

status.text: The latest material shows New Argive as a realm whose walls have guarded it for fifteen centuries, with its last story event being Teferi's healing in its watchtower during the Phyrexian threat.
